title: Safari / iOS form controls and dense-table touch regression triage
creator: Ava Martinez
description: Scope: triage and prioritize a set of cross-browser/responsive regressions surfaced during the 2026 Q1 UI kit sweep. Focus areas: iOS Safari form control layout shifts on autofill and safe-area changes, dense table row tap targets and momentum-scroll regressions on mobile Safari and Android Chrome, Firefox focus-ring overflow on compact tokens and dropdowns, and canvas-based charts pixel-scaling artifacts at non-integer devicePixelRatio. Goal: capture reproducible steps, assign fixes or design workarounds, and land low-risk patches before the 2026.03 console release.
acceptance_criteria: Repro steps for each regression recorded with device/browser and viewport size
Prioritized list (P0/P1/P2) with owner assigned for each item
Design-approved visual fixes or documented workarounds for token/button/table variations
Engineering tickets created with reproduction notes and at least one targetable patch (CSS/JS/markup) or proposal
Regression verification checklist that QA can run in next cycle and pass on supported devices

steps_to_reproduce: Momentum-scroll freeze (mobile Safari): Open /components/tables/dense in iPhone 14 simulator, enable virtualization, rapidly flick the table while background sync triggers — observe stutter and temporary unresponsiveness

Form-control autofill shift (iOS Safari): On iOS Safari, open a form with stacked compact inputs near safe-area inset; trigger autofill; observe sudden vertical shift and overlapping labels when keyboard appears
Firefox focus-ring overflow: In Firefox (desktop), open compact token list with border-radius tokens; tab to tokens and observe focus ring bleeding outside clipping container
Chart pixel-scaling: On high-DPR Android device (devicePixelRatio 2.5), open line chart in dashboard; observe blurred lines and misaligned touch hotspots
proposed_fixes: Add -webkit-overflow-scrolling: touch fallbacks and defer heavy virtualization work during momentum gestures (ENG patch)
Stabilize form layout by reserving min-height for autofill / keyboard state; use env(safe-area-inset-bottom) and CSS transition to avoid janky reflow
Constrain focus outline in Firefox using outline-offset combined with overflow: clip on wrapper or use box-shadow fallback for consistent clipping
Render charts at Math.ceil(width * devicePixelRatio) and scale via CSS to preserve crispness; add explicit hitbox padding for touch interactions
Introduce a low-risk CSS-only fix for button hit area regression: increase min-inline-size and hit padding while preserving visual token size via transform scaling in Figma-approved variants
